blogPosts.title: Signs You Need a Switchboard Upgrade in Dandenong
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn the warning signs that your Dandenong property's switchboard needs upgrading and how it enhances safety and efficiency.
body: Old switchboards are a common issue in Dandenong homes, especially in older suburbs. If your switchboard has ceramic fuses or lacks safety switches, it's time for an upgrade. This prevents electrical fires and shocks, crucial in Dandenong's residential areas.

Dandenong's growing population means increased electrical demand. An outdated switchboard may not handle modern appliances, leading to frequent tripping or overloads. Upgrading ensures your system can support new technologies like air conditioners and solar panels.

Signs to watch for include buzzing noises, flickering lights, or scorch marks on the switchboard. These indicate dangerous faults that require immediate attention from Dandenong electricians. Delaying upgrades can result in blackouts or damage to expensive electronics.

In Dandenong, switchboard upgrades typically cost between $800 and $2,500, depending on the property. We provide fixed quotes, so you know exactly what to expect. Our work complies with AS/NZS 3000 standards, ensuring long-term reliability.

For Dandenong businesses, a modern switchboard reduces downtime and improves energy efficiency. We assess your current setup and recommend solutions that fit your budget, minimising disruption during installation.

At OAM Electrics, we've helped hundreds of Dandenong properties upgrade their switchboards. Our licensed team handles everything from assessment to installation, giving you peace of mind. Contact us for a free quote in Dandenong today.
